title: Use the selected controller theorem without swapping its initial gauge or record type
statement: The visible internally reviewed construction chooses a physical congruence gauge S* S=F. Its long-time counting statistics match the conventional positive-square-root gauge, but its finite-time instrument need not agree from an unchanged initial state. The approximation compares that selected exact controller with its own truncation under the SAME initializer. Creation-operator logarithm is not ordinary matrix logarithm; digital time-binned records are not exact continuous timestamps. Source/calibration/holding costs and missing originals remain.
